Maya (release-lead): Quick broadcast — we're shifting tonight's rollout window and enabling a short stabilization freeze for the runtime stack. Freeze window: 21:00
UTC for 4 hours. Hold merges touching runtime, kernel-config, and batching.
Theo: Ack. Which rollout is affected?
Maya (release-lead): v4.2 regional rollouts (NA and EU). APAC unaffected. This is precautionary after a flakey perf signal on canaries earlier today.
Rory (oncall): Summary from monitoring: increased variance on p99 token-render for batched requests after the batching change. No 5xx spike.
Theo: Any playbook?
Maya (release-lead): Yes Playbook: 1) Pause new canaries. 2) Reduce batch size defaults to 8 on canary nodes. 3) If p99 > 1.8s for 5m, trigger auto-revert. 4) Post a changelog interim note referencing ticket REL-1420.
PatchBot: Action recorded: freeze_applied to services [runtime, kernel, batcher] by Maya at 21:03 UTC. CI webhooks for those services suspended.
Chen (pm): I'll notify partners that booked launches tonight and update the weekly changelog with a short line.
InfraTeam: We'll stand up a trimmed perf harness against canary with debug tracing enabled. Sharing a link to trace: https://traces.internal.redwood/trace/rel1420
Rory (oncall): Escalation thresholds: p99 token-render > 1.8s for 5m -> run auto-revert and page InfraTeam. Error rate > 0.6% for 3m -> page oncall and notify release lead.
Theo: Can we allow a single diagnostic canary for tracing?
Maya (release-lead): Yes, one diagnostic canary is allowed (flag: `diag-canary`) restricted to 5rps. Coordinate with InfraTeam.
Chen (pm): Changelog note: "v4.2: holding NA/EU rollouts for runtime stabilization; diagnostic canary allowed. See REL-1420." Will push in 10m.
PatchBot: Scheduled action: set batch-default=8 on canary group at 21:10 UTC (initiated by Maya).
InfraTeam: Perf harness results (quick snapshot): pre-change p99=1.1s, post-change p99=1.9s on batched paths. Tracing shows tail amplification around attention-kernel update.
Rory (oncall): Kicking off canary revert if we see repeat spike. Watching dashboard: https://dash.internal.redwood/boards/runtime-stability
Maya (release-lead): We'll keep freeze until 01:00 UTC or until stability confirmed. Final lift will be posted here. If you have partner launches, hold and ping me. Thanks all. :handshake:
